subject: Upcoming Team Building Event
body: Dear team members, We are excited to announce that our annual team building event will be held on Friday, April 15th, at the local park. The event will include fun team activities, a catered lunch, and an opportunity to bond with your colleagues outside of work. Please RSVP by April 8th so we can finalize the arrangements. We look forward to seeing you all there! Best regards, [Company Name] HR Team
